policy: Process-wide scheduler capacity and overhead budgets (AGENTS.md: budgets before optimization; include low-core workloads). Capacity rows bound each engine thread pool's workers and their total; a live census (scheduler_budgets.py census) compares a running product with them. Overhead rows are regression gates on the declared runner: limits are about twice the worst median seen across three interleaved runs on a shared, frequency-scaled host, so they catch lost wakes, polling and serialization, not small drifts. A profile without its own measurements is unverified.

measurement.pool_bench: median microseconds per sample of unittests/jobsystemtest/threadpoolbench.cpp at the row's worker count (release --tests tree); every sample is validated before it counts
measurement.graph_node_ns: nanoseconds added per node by the serial frame graph over a direct call loop (hostframetest MeasureOverhead) at the row's node count
measurement.census: threads of a running Portal product by OS thread name with the index stripped; tier0 names pool workers <pool><index> on Linux

linux-x86_64-desktop.runner: AMD RYZEN AI MAX+ PRO 395 (16 cores / 32 threads), Linux 7.2, g++ 16.2.1 release --tests tree

capacity.note: CmpJob is the engine compute pool (physical cores - 1, capped at 3 unless -threads); IOJob the filesystem async pool (capped at 4: the cap was lost upstream in f2fa241a and restored here, 32 -> 4 workers on this runner); MatQueue exists only in queued material-system modes. Census 2026-09-24, testchmb_a_00 native Vulkan: CmpJob 3, IOJob 4, SaveJob 1, no MatQueue (8 workers). Dedicated threads (audio, packet sender, achievement save) are not pools.

baseline.host_load: load average 4-6 during the runs; CPU frequency scaling active
baseline.in_game: perf profile, testchmb_a_02 headless native Vulkan, 3781 frames: main thread 7.41 ms/frame steady, of which caller-side pooled batch dispatch (particles, bones) 0.070 ms and host frame graph executor under 0.01 ms (RFC/0003-scheduler-nodes-progress.md)

portal-android-native-vulkan.note: Same pool policy applies (CmpJob physical-1 capped at 3, IOJob logical capped at 4); no device census or benchmark yet. Mobile power/thermal budgets need R29 device runs.
